reviewed.DEBIAN-CVE-2025-46206: NOT-AFFECTED — infinite recursion in the `mutool clean` utility. mutool is not shipped (ADR-0010). The shim calls pdf_save_document directly and never mutool.
reviewed.DEBIAN-CVE-2025-55780: NOT-AFFECTED — null dereference rendering a malformed EPUB. This application opens PDF; EPUB is not a registered format and no EPUB path is reachable. Revisit if EPUB import is ever added (Stage 8).
reviewed.DEBIAN-CVE-2025-71382: NOT-AFFECTED — uncontrolled recursion in the EPUB CSS rendering engine, fixed before 1.27.0-rc1 and therefore before our 1.28.0. Doubly inapplicable: no EPUB path exists.
reviewed.DEBIAN-CVE-2026-3308: UNRESOLVED — integer overflow in pdf-image.c, reported against 1.27.0. Debian records fixes in its own package versions, which do not map onto upstream releases, so whether 1.28.0 carries the fix is NOT established. Treated as potentially affecting us until upstream release notes are read. Same evaluation as CVE-2026-7233.
reviewed.DEBIAN-CVE-2026-40505: NOT-AFFECTED — ANSI escape injection through mutool's terminal output. mutool is not shipped (ADR-0010 withdrew it) and this application has no terminal output path for document-derived text.
reviewed.DEBIAN-CVE-2026-7233: AFFECTED — names "Artifex MuPDF up to 1.28.0", which is our pinned version. Out-of-bounds read in fz_subset_cff_for_gids (subset-cff.c, CFF index handler). CVSS:3.1 AV:L/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:L/I:N/A:H. Exploit publicly disclosed; upstream had not responded at time of publication. REACHABLE HERE: font subsetting runs on save/export, so a crafted CFF font in an opened document reaches it. Not reachable on open alone. DECISION: evaluate 1.28.1/1.28.2 as the fix path — see docs/JOURNAL.md. Until then the shim is built with GUARD_CF, NX_COMPAT, HIGH_ENTROPY_VA and /GS, which do not prevent an out-of-bounds READ. This is an open item, not a closed one.
